items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 08 June 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving complex low to the northwest of Britain.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 tonight. Little change tomorrow morning, then decreasing West 4 or 5 in the west of the area in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Scattered showers.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Decreasing West 4 or 5 in all waters tomorrow evening, then 3 or 4 on Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, falling slight.


##Weather##

Showers, becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.
